sourcePolicy: Only direct, explicitly person-owned, source-backed Arabic biography material counts toward the 500-word threshold. Documentary context, incidental name matches, metadata, navigation text and unrelated source passages do not count.
sparseEvidenceRule: If verified direct evidence remains below 500 words after repository/Drive-derived extraction, retain SOURCE_LIMITED status and the exact residual count; never pad the biography with unrelated context or invented history.
provenance: Every added passage must retain repository/source/extract identifiers and remain auditable.
localizationRule: The strict 500-word audit is Arabic-first. Arabic source extensions must not be injected into English or French pages as a substitute for localization.
